All modules

dest

components · 0.4.0 · B1 · aj-c-dest

The five destinations: Today, Reflections, Timeline, Ask, You. Always five, always in that order: Reflections next to Today (v4 B7), You set apart from the journal four (revision 28). A compact header row on the web, a column in the desktop title block; never a bottom bar on mobile web. The native app's tab bar keeps its own four until app development starts.
